newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan exports rise to $1.688 billion.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan exports rise to $1.688 billion.

text.p: Philippine merchandise exports in January rose to $1.688 billion, up 18.8 percent from $1.420 billion in the same period last year, the National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
Manufactured goods, which account for the bulk of exports, rose in January to $1.433 billion, up 21.4 percent from $1.180 billion in January, 1995.
Manufactured goods exports were dominated by electronics and components which accounted for $732.86 million, up from $559.71 million in the same period last year.
Almost a third of the shipments of electronics and components had gone to the United States, the National Statistics Office said.
Another component of the manufactured goods sector, apparel and clothing accesories, showed lower exports in January compared to last year.
Income from apparel and clothing accessories fell to $144.29 million from $197.54 million in january 1996. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841 8934
